en: A winter-themed biathlon World Cup '97 souvenir postcard with purple snowflake border and Japanese text at the top, including event dates and location. The right side has an illustration of a cartoon beaver on skis with a rifle on its back inside a frame labeled "Biathlon World Cup'97 NOZAWAONSEN CROSS COUNTRY SHOOTING 3/6·8·9". The left side bears several Japanese postage stamps (including Olympic-themed and bird stamps) with commemorative postmarks. The center contains handwritten address and message in Estonian, as well as multiple signatures at the bottom.
